scope: Fixed-build controlled calibration after inspected ARIA/title input failures. Shared action histories and comparison groups are deliberate; not an independent evaluation. Raw model inputs and contexts are retained; only DOM identity is adapted in the independent verification view. Reading-target agreement uses Native geometry/AX, not keyboard focus; it remains narrower than general logical-cursor Navigation Accuracy. Declared state fields, model-changing boolean transitions, keyboard focus and task outcomes are independently observed in both environments. This calibration has no state-changing actions; its unchanged enabled-state outcome is only a fixture-health check, not task-performance evidence. Transition denominator records model-changing states, distinct from repeated state-field snapshots; it does not measure text selections, values or a general transition model. Literal Full compares actual model windows with differing observation durations; no queue/completion/timing parity claim. All planned failures/missing/unmeasured rows retained. Now inspected regression; no broad 90% or representative-web claim.

plan.sourceState: Collection worktree with pending evaluator diagnostics and the speech-input observation method; full source/build hashes retained, not a pristine commit build.
plan.question: Calibration after inspected missing-title-help failures: isolate referenced/attribute ARIA description with absent, different and equal title help in both Native browsers.
plan.hypothesis: Safari may expose title help together with inline ARIA description while Chrome omits the superseded title. Equal strings must not replace observed source relationships. Do not change rules or inputs until both Native profiles finish.
plan.protocol: Same shared HTML and complete command sequences in both Native browsers. Freeze actual Rawstep model outputs, semantic inputs, previous speech contexts and independent renderer DOM/control state before Native. Rawstep owns movement; no new navigation implementation. Speech data never selects targets or supplies model inputs.
plan.inputPolicy: Preserve exact diagnostic input and previousContext. For the Native verifier only, join the actual model target backendDOMNodeId to its independently read renderer DOM id; retain both original identity and mapping. This ID-only verification view does not alter model input or prediction. Container IDs retain actual model identities. Native target and previous ancestor context still require independent geometry/AX confirmation.
metrics: literal Full Speech Exact of actual model windows
plan.limits: Inspected-failure controlled calibration, not an independent evaluation. Action-sequence overlap is deliberate and recorded. The unchanged enabled-state oracle only checks fixture health, not task-generalization performance. A diagnostic input is not an AX/VO cursor oracle. Model 900ms observation windows and Native bounded receipt windows do not establish equal timing, causal attribution, completion or native queue behavior. Preserve every failed/missing/unmeasured row.

acquisition.scope: Controlled calibration before any input observer or adapter change; sources fixed until both Native profiles finish.
